title: Which teams have been been relegated from the ...
content: With the 2022-23 Bundesliga season drawing to a close this weekend, Matchday 34 features a tightly contested four-way battle to beat the drop and avoid relegation from Germany’s top flight. Hertha Berlin’s relegation was confirmed back on Matchday 33, as they conceded a disappointing equalizer in the last minute to draw 1-1 with Bochum. Schalke currently sit in 17th place with 31 points and with a 2-2 draw with Eintracht Frankfurt back on Matchday 33, it means they at least need one point on the final day of the season to avoid automatic relegation and potentially a relegation play-off altogether. Bochum sit in 16th place with 32 points and if the season were to end today, they would head into a relegation play-off to decide the club’s future in the Bundesliga for next season. A win against Bayer Leverkusen on the final day of the season will surely be enough to avoid automatic relegation, and potentially a play-off matchup as well.

content: # Bundesliga 2 promotion race and relegation battle: Who secured promotion and who went down? Elversberg, Paderborn and Hannover battled it out to join Schalke in the Bundesliga, while four teams were at risk of following Preußen Münster down to the third tier on a dramatic final day in Bundesliga 2... Schalke secured promotion to the Bundesliga after beating Fortuna Düsseldorf at home on Matchday 32. They were confirmed as Bundesliga 2 champions the following day after Paderborn failed to beat Elversberg. With Elversberg, Hannover and Paderborn level on 59 points heading into the final matchday, it was all to play for. Elversberg prevailed, beating relegated Preußen Münster 3-0 to secure a maiden promotion to the Bundesliga. Paderborn finished third after a 2-0 victory over Darmstadt, meaning they will play Wolfsburg in the play-off. It means that the Clover Leaves will play Rot-Weiss Essen for a place in next season's Bundesliga 2, while Fortuna follow Münster into Germany's 3.
